subject: POC kickoff & capacity planning — GridSight (routing, load test, token budget)
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@gridsight.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0500
Subject: POC kickoff & capacity planning — GridSight

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As discussed, next step is a hands-on POC so your team can exercise routing profiles, run prompt review sessions, and execute a short loadtest to validate token budgets. Proposed agenda (45–60m):

- 10m: Quick goals & success criteria (you + us)
- 15m: Prompt review and routing / fallback plan walkthrough (Aditya)
- 15m: Load test plan & quotas (Marissa + Dylan)
- 5–10m: Action items and follow-ups (owners + deadlines)

Two logistical points for us to confirm: whether you want to run the initial loadtests against our Hosted endpoint (fastest onboarding) or our Dedicated trial (predictable throughput & isolation). If Dedicated, we need a short quota bump and a capacity reservation — that will take an additional day to provision.

Can you share a 60-minute window next week (US EST preferred) and confirm whether Dedicated or Hosted for the initial loadtest? Also let us know if you require any compliance artifacts beforehand — I can attach SOC2 and data handling notes.

Attaching a draft POC runbook and token budget estimate for your review.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Sales PM | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0134

Attachments: POC_runbook_v2.pdf, token_budget_estimate.xlsx

From: Samir Patel <samir@gridsight.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Nina Cho <nina@gridsight.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & capacity planning — GridSight

Thanks Laura — this looks great. We prefer a Dedicated trial for the loadtest because our data sets are large and we want to verify steady-state latency under sustained traffic. A couple of asks:

- Can Redwood provide a short quota bump (roughly 3x of the baseline) for a 2-hour window for the initial loadtest?
- We need SOC2 evidence and a short network diagram for our security review before we run anything in Dedicated.
- Timewise: week of Nov 30 works for our team. Prefer Tue/Wed morning PST.

If you can provision the quota early in the week and share the SOC2 snapshot, we can lock a slot.

—Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Engineering | GridSight

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:26:00 -0500
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & capacity planning — GridSight

Laura / Marissa —

Agree Dedicated trial makes sense given GridSight's needs. Operational notes from infra:

- Short provisioning path: we can do a 48h standby for a small Dedicated pool and apply a temporary quota bump for a scheduled 2-hour window. Need a signed MA/PO or tracker note from Sales to authorize.
- For the loadtest, we'll prepare two routing profiles: "primary-dedicated" and "fallback-hosted" to verify graceful degradation. That lets GridSight see Dedicated performance and an automatic fallback if we hit capacity or throttles.
- Token budget: the attached estimate assumes 1.2k concurrent short-form requests with ~350 tokens/request. If you want to test longer contexts we should adjust the estimate.

Action items I can take: coordinate the Dedicated reservation with Ops, prepare routing config, and validate quotas. Need confirmation of exact test time and a contact for their infra team (Samir or Nina).

- Aditya

---
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@gridsight.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 08:14:00 -0500
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & capacity planning — GridSight

Hi Samir —

Quick update: Ops confirmed we can do a temporary 3x quota bump for a 2-hour window but need a confirmed slot and a short ticket (I created the request pending scheduling). Laura, Dylan and I had a calendar conflict on Wed morning so can you confirm Tue Dec 1 at 11:00 AM EST (8:00 AM PST) instead? That avoids the conflict and still meets GridSight's "week of Nov 30" preference.

Soojin will be on the call for the prompt review and will bring the routing playbook. Aditya will validate the Dedicated reservation and put fallback routing in place. Dylan will run the loadtest plan.

I'll attach the runbook v2 and the token budget estimate — please review before the call so we can keep the session to 60 minutes.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Manager, Technical Onboarding | Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir@gridsight.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Nina Cho <nina@gridsight.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 13:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & capacity planning — GridSight

Thanks everyone — Tue Dec 1 at 8:00 AM PST works for us (confirmed). We've uploaded a short network diagram to the Drive link you sent and Nina will be on the call for security questions.

Two quick notes before we meet:
- GridSight will provide a signed work order this afternoon to authorize the quota bump. Expect an emailed PO reference.
- For the loadtest, we'll start with the baseline traffic (500 r/s) for 20m and then step to the target (1.2k r/s) for 40m. Please confirm the fallback-hosted path will preserve request ordering and KV-cache behavior for evaluation.

See you on the call — Samir

Attachments referenced: SOC2_snapshot_2026-11.pdf (we requested), POC_runbook_v2.pdf (from Redwood)
